items.title: Chartist 2.0: The Lightweight SVG Charting Library Returns
items.blurb: Simple, responsive charts drawn in SVG and styled with CSS. Tiny, typed, and happy without a build step.

items.title: Pele: Mermaid Diagrams as Lightweight, Themeable SVG
items.blurb: Pele is a lightweight open source library that renders Mermaid diagrams to SVG, themed with CSS variables.

items.title: Try the playground
items.blurb: Edit diagrams and compare Pele with Mermaid.

items.title: what it's able to render in under 100 bytes
items.blurb: JXL art gallery with links to source code. Procedural images as tiny JPEG XL files (SDR).

items.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources fx: A Zig Coding Agent Designed to Be Embedded
items.blurb: Vercel Labs has released fx, an experimental open-source coding agent written in Zig. It runs as a CLI, a script component, or an embedded library, including a WebAssembly build.

items.title: go/ links that live in a file in your repo (open source)
items.blurb: Chrome and Firefox extension that does this for your twigg repository. The links are defined in a GOLINKS file at the root of the repo, one alias per line. Add a line, push, submit and done. No admin page, and changes are versioned.
